snapshot_source: Metrica Sports sample data: Games 1-2 CSV (RawEventsData, RawTrackingData), Game 3 FIFA EPTS (metadata.xml + tracking.txt + events.json). Enumeration of fields consumed by ingestion.metrica_{common,events,tracking} as of 2026-04-20.
notes: Tracking bronze schema is unified across CSV + EPTS paths: both paths emit the same 12 columns. Pitch-dim cols are NaN for CSV-source games (Games 1-2) since the CSV header doesn't carry <FieldSize>.
Events bronze schema is unified across CSV + EPTS paths: both paths emit 19 columns. subtypes_all_json + pitch-dim cols are NULL/NaN for CSV-source games.

Player x/y coordinates are bundled into the home_players / away_players JSON columns (one JSON dict per frame mapping jersey→{x,y}) rather than separate per-player columns — this is a compression, not a drop: every player's position is reachable via JSON path.
When Metrica releases new sample games or changes the EPTS schema, update this fixture + parser in the same PR.

source_to_bronze.epts_player_x_y_per_frame: home_players / away_players (JSON bundle, split by team_id)

excluded_source_fields.epts_metadata_Player_ShirtName: Jersey name / display string; not useful for analysis — downstream uses numeric shirt number.
excluded_source_fields.epts_metadata_Team_Name: Team display name; not independently captured (team_id already identifies). Potential follow-up if display-name joins are needed.
excluded_source_fields.csv_file_raw_column_order: CSV column order is provider-specific; bronze schema is normalised to a fixed column set.
